errors.text_span: Етикетите на оста X са разположени на всеки две години, започвайки от 2008 и завършвайки на 2018.
errors.evidence: The labels on the X-axis are for every single year from 2008 to 2018, not every two years as stated.

The description omits a crucial part of the Y-axis label. The full label is 'Производителност на труда, хил.лв на заето лице' (Labor productivity, thousand BGN per employed person). Omitting 'per employed person' changes the meaning of the unit.
The blue line is described as having square markers, but the figure shows it has circular markers.
The description incorrectly states that the orange line decreases ('намалява') from 2008 to 2009. The value actually increases from 30.758 to 34.300.

errors.text_span: достига максимална стойност от 65.018 през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the maximum value for the orange line. The actual maximum value is 66.622, which occurred in 2012, not 65.018 in 2017.
